label: Assassin (top half — chest up)
_srcNote: Man_Rig_Correct.glb is the working second rig source (assassin.glb has zero exported bones — it's a static mesh, not rigged). If anchor lookup fails on a future asset swap, src/anim/rig_compose.js dumps the available bone names to console so you can pick the right anchor.
_anchorNote: anchorBone is the bone that the composer attaches as a child of the bottom part's hip joint. For 'top' parts this is typically Spine1 (chest); the chain Spine1 → Neck → Head → arms comes along.
_materialNote: Override entries are filled in by the rig_compose tool — keys appear here so authors know what slots exist.
